evidence: Workbook Quality row 36 and skill quality-checks.md ###36 require every distinctive value a criterion tells the judge to create to be absent from the seed and reference markup; deterministic row check-probe-not-in-seed.py (manual application, private checker not run) says the same. Enumerated judge-created values across all five judge.toml/prompt.md files: (1) gates/constraints hro_gate_shared and every scored prompt's global gate create a job with a 'unique title' (suffixed 'for this review') and a candidate with unique name/email; functional prompt.md:49 requires suffixing every title and name for this review and never relying on starting counts; jobs J1/J2/J3 and cards A-F, V-Z, A2 are judge-created and labelled only. Seed has exactly 3 jobs (Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer) and 16 applications, none of which a suffixed title/name can collide with. (2) Literal probes: functional hro_msg_compose message 'plain' and polish hro_pol_live_board example note 'Call back on Fri' - grep -F for '', 'Call back', 'Fri', 'J1','J2','J3', 'GATE', 'PROBE' over environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/src/seed_data.json (byte-identical, sha256 a1c65c80...e83740 matching raw-evidence-index), solution/app/public, src, server.js: zero hits (only 'text/plain' dataTransfer in board.js:242/303 and 'plain text' prose in hireops_rules.md:138, neither a pre-satisfaction). (3) Tomas linkage: seed has Tomas only on APP-201 (JOB-DATA, SCREEN); the criterion requires a NEW card on the judge's suffixed J2 (functional prompt.md:73 opens J3 if the address is already on J2), and hro_candidate_linked owns only the new J2 link, so his seeded Data Analyst application cannot satisfy it. (4) State-change readbacks (Activity lines, notes, rejection reasons, drafts, unread counts, seen markers) all target judge-created jobs/cards or the new J2 conversation; seed keys are stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users, jobs, applications, messages, notes(3), reads(6) - no activity and no drafts key, so Activity lines for J1/J2 and Mei's empty draft boxes (hro_pol_session_resume) cannot be pre-satisfied. Seeded values the judge reads (Platform Engineer order, Noor's note, Lena's 1 unread, Noor's 120-message thread) are observation baselines, not probes the judge creates. Counterexample attempts: a static/hardcoded app cannot display judge-chosen suffixed titles/names, 'plain' or a new J2 conversation, so it cannot pass probe rows from seed data; a conforming app is not harmed because no probe value collides with seed content. No runtime run needed for this static check; scripted golden or judge runs were not used as evidence here.
